name: loadcraft
description: Run load tests on LoadCraft from your editor: prepare source-grounded OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, journey and project-overview artifacts, then create, run and read load tests.

loadcraft_url.title: LoadCraft web app (browser address)
loadcraft_url.description: Only for a local or self-hosted LoadCraft. The address you open in the browser to use LoadCraft; links in tool results point here. Not the backend API address. Default: https://app.loadcraft.io.

api_token.title: LoadCraft API token
api_token.description: API token created in LoadCraft settings. Stored in the system credential store.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: Try the plugin with sample data, without a LoadCraft account.

api_url.title: Backend API address (leave empty if same as web app)
api_url.description: Only when the backend runs at a different address than the web app, e.g. local development with separate ports. Full address including /api/v1. Empty: <web app address>/api/v1.
